items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: He made me aware of this record. And he sat down and he said, “You’ve got to hear this.”

ctx.x: Can you remember the very first time you heard that recording?

Oh, clearly, clearly. John Eaton, the piano player in Washington who you may or may not know, he’s a wonderful solo pianist, and he does a lot of concerts for the Smithsonian Institute, and he’s a brilliant piano player. He made me aware of this record. And he sat down and he said, “You’ve got to hear this.” I said okay. I sat down and listened to it, and like I said it really —
